_**User**_

Create the following file:

knowledge/engineering/WRITING_STANDARD.md

The document title should be:

# Writing Standard

Purpose:

Define a single writing style for the entire AI Engineering Kit repository.

The document should explain that every future document must follow the exact same structure.

Create the following sections.

1. Philosophy

Explain that documents are written for both engineers and AI agents.

The human reader always comes first.

AI should consume documentation naturally instead of relying on prompt engineering.

--------------------------------

2. Document Structure

Every document should follow this order whenever possible:

- Title

- Purpose

- Why it matters

- Principles

- Rules

- Good examples

- Bad examples

- Checklist

- Related documents

--------------------------------

3. Writing Style

Rules:

Use simple English.

Prefer short paragraphs.

Avoid buzzwords.

Avoid marketing language.

Never exaggerate.

Never write vague recommendations.

Every recommendation must be actionable.

Explain why.

Explain trade-offs.

--------------------------------

4. Examples

Whenever possible provide both:

Good Example

Bad Example

--------------------------------

5. Checklists

Every practical document should end with a checklist.

--------------------------------

6. File Naming

Use lowercase.

Use kebab-case.

Examples:

component-design.md

api-design.md

wordpress-security.md

--------------------------------

7. Tone

Professional.

Educational.

Objective.

Opinionated only when backed by engineering reasoning.

--------------------------------

8. AI Compatibility

Explain that documents should avoid references to specific AI models whenever possible.

Knowledge should remain tool-independent.

--------------------------------

9. Definition of Done

A document is complete only if:

Purpose is clear.

Examples exist.

Checklist exists.

Reader can immediately apply the knowledge.

--------------------------------

Write in high quality GitHub Markdown.

No emojis.

No marketing language.

No filler text.
